title: Ukraine and Russia both report fake emergency alerts after cyberattacks target apps as limited ceasefire ends
content_md: AP reports: Authorities in Ukraine and Russia said their emergency alert mobile apps had been targeted by cyberattacks, with users in Ukraine receiving false warnings of an imminent nuclear threat. It was not clear if the attacks late Sunday were related.
